evidence.summary: Autonomous production completed as a 124-page standard-color paperback and semantic EPUB with 127 official Cerema sign assets and a source-linked bilingual inventory.

blockers: Legifrance anti-bot response blocked local HTML archival; current consolidated content was verified live and URL/version metadata were retained.
rework_causes: Corrected B21 arrow-family designations during independent legal-source reconciliation.
Removed a non-embedded default PDF font and moved to an even 124-page interior.
contract_deviations: Final word count is below the indicative range because the finished product is a sign-dominant atlas; useful visual coverage was preserved without prose padding.

decisions.reason: Source, rights, 127-entry crosswalk, bilingual, visual, print and EPUB gates passed; only cover selection, KDP upload/Previewer and final commercial confirmation remain human gates.
